facts.text: John is considering starting a community project related to infrastructure improvements.

evidence.quote: Thanks for the offer, Maria. I'm thinking about starting a community project regarding infrastructure, so maybe we can work together to get the neighborhood's backing.

facts.text: John references an image of a group of people looking at a map, which prompts him to emphasize the importance of fighting for better housing and living conditions in their neighborhood.

evidence.quote: That pic makes me think of how important it is to fight for better housing and living conditions in our neighborhood. We can definitely make a difference!
Let's work together to get the community involved and make a difference. [image: a photography of a group of people looking at a map]

facts.text: Maria agrees with John's focus on affordable housing and emphasizes the importance of community involvement to improve living standards.

evidence.quote: Definitely, John! It's important that everyone has access to affordable housing. Let's get the community on board and fight for better living standards. We can make a difference!

facts.text: John mentions that he wants to work on improving his old area, West County, as part of the community project.

evidence.quote: I want to work on improving my old area, West County, too.
